# Secure Webhook Token (SWT)

> Secure Webhook Token (SWT) is an IETF Internet-Draft specification (`draft-knauer-secure-webhook-token-03`) defining a specialized JSON Web Token (JWT) profile for cryptographically bound, replay-protected webhook authentication over HTTPS POST.

## Why SWT Fits AI Agents & Autonomous Workflows

In autonomous agentic systems (A2A, MCP, async tool callbacks), incoming webhook payloads feed directly into an LLM's context window:

- **Cryptographic Payload Integrity for AI Agent Workflows**: `webhook.hash` binds the raw HTTP body to the signed JWT so tampered or unauthenticated payloads are rejected before reaching downstream agents. (SWT proves sender authenticity and payload integrity; it does not sanitize malicious instructions from an authorized sender or replace prompt-injection defenses.)
- **Stateless Reactive Wakeups & Cost Protection**: Dormant agents resume only when an authentic, unexpired token with verified `iss` and `aud` arrives; atomic `jti` replay protection blocks duplicate wakeups.
- **Cross-Boundary Provenance**: `iss`, `aud` (when used), and `webhook.retry_count` establish verifiable delivery context without shared session state.

## Core Protocol Summary

- **Normative Source**: `draft-knauer-secure-webhook-token-03` (the IETF Internet-Draft is authoritative).
- **Transport & Header**: HTTPS POST (`TLS 1.2+`, `TLS 1.3` recommended) with `Authorization: Bearer <SWT>`.
- **Header**: `alg` (`HS256`, `HS384`, `HS512`, `RS256`, `ES256` — reject `none`), `typ: "SWT"`, optional `kid`.
- **Required Claims**: `webhook` (`event`, `hash` for non-empty bodies, optional `retry_count`), `iss`, `exp`, `nbf`, `iat`, `jti`. `aud` is RECOMMENDED in general and REQUIRED for asymmetric keys or multi-subscriber delivery.

## Agent & Machine-Readable Resources

- [Full Agent Implementation Guide](https://securewebhooktoken.github.io/llms-full.txt): 10-section receiver/sender implementation guide aligned with Draft-03.
- [SWT Claims JSON Schema](https://securewebhooktoken.github.io/schemas/swt-claims.schema.json): JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for SWT payload validation.
- [SWT Conformance Test Suite](https://github.com/SecureWebhookToken/swt-conformance): Language-independent conformance runner, schemas, test-only keys, and 56 Draft-03 test vectors (`vectors/draft-03/`).
- [Runnable Node.js Reference Verifier](https://github.com/SecureWebhookToken/securewebhooktoken.github.io/blob/main/examples/swt-verifier.mjs): Zero-dependency 18-step verifier.
- [Runnable Python Reference Verifier](https://github.com/SecureWebhookToken/securewebhooktoken.github.io/blob/main/examples/swt_verifier.py): Zero-dependency 18-step verifier.
- [SWT Agent Skill](https://github.com/SecureWebhookToken/securewebhooktoken.github.io/tree/main/skills/secure-webhook-token): Reusable Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`, references, and test vectors).
- [Interactive SWT Playground](https://securewebhooktoken.github.io/playground/): Client-side Web Crypto generator and verifier.
